risks: Max context times concurrency asks for about 1M tokens of KV cache but only about 70k-90k tokens fit on one L4, so vLLM will preempt and recompute and throughput will stall.
Every reply is forced to 4096 tokens with EOS ignored, so the run is a worst-case load test not representative throughput.
vLLM 0.6.4.post1 needs numpy below 2 and a source build of pyairports, so the standard probe image with numpy 2.1.3 cannot install it.
